title: Every Firebase auth failure — real token or systemic outage — collapses into the same silent 401
/health has no worker-liveness signal, and a failed in-process worker start is caught, logged, and ignored
No request/job correlation anywhere: zero logger.child() calls, and Fastify's own request logger is disabled with nothing replacing it
SSE-driven LLM generation failures (sim-script + guidance) are never logged
Pipeline-stats has no metric that would have caught a past incident — no job success rate, duration, queue depth, or ffmpeg failure count
A failed collaborator-invite claim during signup is silently dropped, with no log and no user-visible signal
console.log/console.error mixed with logger.* in the transcode job, bypassing pino entirely
lib/sse.ts is dead code — every live SSE endpoint reimplements its own emitter/heartbeat instead
